assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and a history of atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a diagnosis of atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10).
The patient has a history of atrial fibrillation (I48.91).
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or ischemic changes that may not be captured on standard ambulatory monitoring.
The procedure is required to evaluate the patient's condition given the diagnosis codes R55, I25.10, and I48.91.
